<include name="Layout_Labels_ShowTitle">
        <param name="fade">false</param>
        <param name="selected">false</param>
        <param name="include_detailed_labels">Skin.HasSetting(View.UseDetailedListLabels)</param>
        <param name="use_label">false</param>
        <param name="use_label2">false</param>
        <param name="aligny">top</param>
        <param name="textbox_offset_y">7</param>
        <param name="item_w">410</param>
        <definition>
            <control type="image">
                <texture border="20" colordiffuse="e7ffffff">common/poster_fade.png</texture>
                <visible>$PARAM[fade]</visible>
                <height>$PARAM[item_h]</height>
            </control>

            <control type="group">
                <top>$PARAM[item_h]</top>
                <control type="group">
                    <top>$PARAM[top]</top>
                    <left>$PARAM[left]</left>
                    <right>$PARAM[right]</right>
                    <height>80</height>

                    <control type="group">
                        <top>$PARAM[textbox_offset_y]</top>
                        <visible>![$PARAM[include_detailed_labels]]</visible>

                        <control type="label">
                            <width>$PARAM[item_w]</width>
                            <height>33</height>
                            <font>font_mini</font>
                            <label>$VAR[Label_ShowTitle_Upper]</label>
                            <align>left</align>
                            <include condition="$PARAM[selected]">Color_SelectedText</include>
                            <textcolor>main_fg_70</textcolor>
                        </control>

                        <control type="label">
                            <top>33</top>
                            <width>$PARAM[item_w]</width>
                            <height>33</height>
                            <font>font_mini</font>
                            <label>$VAR[Label_ShowTitle_Lower]</label>
                            <align>left</align>
                            <scroll>$PARAM[selected]</scroll>
                            <include condition="$PARAM[selected]">Color_SelectedText</include>
                            <textcolor>main_fg_70</textcolor>
                        </control>
                    </control>

                    <include content="Object_InfoCircle_Text_Top" condition="$PARAM[include_detailed_labels]">
                        <label>$INFO[$PARAM[listitem].Label]</label>
                        <include condition="$PARAM[selected]">Color_SelectedText</include>
                        <textcolor>$PARAM[textcolor]_90</textcolor>
                        <align>left</align>
                        <selectedcolor>$PARAM[textcolor]_90</selectedcolor>
                    </include>

                    <control type="group">
                        <include content="Object_InfoCircle_Text_Sub" condition="$PARAM[include_detailed_labels]">
                            <label>$VAR[Label_Landscape_Lower$PARAM[affix]]</label>
                            <include condition="$PARAM[selected]">Color_SelectedText</include>
                            <textcolor>$PARAM[textcolor]_70</textcolor>
                            <selectedcolor>$PARAM[textcolor]_70</selectedcolor>
                            <align>left</align>
                        </include>
                        <include content="Object_InfoCircle_Text_Sub" condition="$PARAM[include_detailed_labels]">
                            <label>$INFO[$PARAM[listitem].StartTime]$INFO[$PARAM[listitem].EndTime, - ,]</label>
                            <include condition="$PARAM[selected]">Color_SelectedText</include>
                            <textcolor>$PARAM[textcolor]_70</textcolor>
                            <selectedcolor>$PARAM[textcolor]_70</selectedcolor>
                            <align>right</align>
                            <visible>!String.IsEmpty($PARAM[listitem].ChannelNumberLabel)</visible>
                            <visible>ListItem.InProgress</visible>
                        </include>
                        <include content="Object_InfoCircle_Text_Sub" condition="$PARAM[include_detailed_labels]">
                            <label>$INFO[$PARAM[listitem].Date]</label>
                            <include condition="$PARAM[selected]">Color_SelectedText</include>
                            <textcolor>$PARAM[textcolor]_70</textcolor>
                            <selectedcolor>$PARAM[textcolor]_70</selectedcolor>
                            <align>right</align>
                            <visible>!String.IsEmpty($PARAM[listitem].ChannelNumberLabel)</visible>
                            <visible>!ListItem.InProgress</visible>
                        </include>
                    </control>
                </control>
            </control>
        </definition>
    </include>

    <include name="Layout_Landscape_ShowTitle">
        <param name="detailed">false</param>
        <param name="selected">false</param>
        <param name="icon">$VAR[Image_Landscape]</param>
        <param name="textcolor">main_fg</param>
        <param name="diffuse">diffuse/landscape_w410_h231.png</param>
        <param name="listitem">ListItem</param>
        <param name="progress">Progress</param>
        <param name="affix" />
        <definition>
            <control type="group">

                <width>$PARAM[item_w]</width>
                <height>$PARAM[item_h]</height>

                <include content="Object_ItemBack">
                    <param name="selected">$PARAM[selected]</param>
                    <param name="shadow_colordiffuse">$PARAM[shadow_colordiffuse]</param>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_Control" condition="$PARAM[selected]">
                    <param name="control">image</param>
                    <include>Texture_Box_Highlight_V</include>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_Layout_Image_Rectangle" condition="![$PARAM[detailed]]">
                    <param name="diffuse">$PARAM[diffuse]</param>
                    <param name="icon">$PARAM[icon]</param>
                    <param name="listitem">$PARAM[listitem]</param>
                    <param name="selected">$PARAM[selected]</param>
                    <param name="aspectratio">keep</param>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_Layout_Image_Rectangle" condition="$PARAM[detailed]">
                    <param name="diffuse">$PARAM[diffuse]</param>
                    <param name="icon">$PARAM[icon]</param>
                    <param name="listitem">$PARAM[listitem]</param>
                    <param name="selected">$PARAM[selected]</param>
                    <param name="aspectratio">scale</param>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_ClearLogo_WithShadow">
                    <param name="diffuse">$PARAM[diffuse]</param>
                    <param name="icon">$INFO[$PARAM[listitem].Art(clearlogo)]</param>
                    <visible>[String.IsEqual($PARAM[listitem].DBType,movie) | String.IsEqual($PARAM[listitem].DBType,tvshow)] + String.IsEmpty($PARAM[listitem].Art(landscape)) + String.IsEmpty($PARAM[listitem].Art(tvshow.landscape))</visible>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_ProgressLine">
                    <param name="progress">$PARAM[listitem].$PARAM[progress]</param>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_Indicator" condition="!$PARAM[selected]">
                    <param name="affix">$PARAM[affix]</param>
                    <param name="listitem">$PARAM[listitem]</param>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_ContentBanner" condition="$PARAM[indicator]">
                    <param name="listitem">$PARAM[listitem]</param>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_TraktOverlays" condition="$PARAM[indicator] + [Skin.HasSetting(Indicator.TraktWatchlist) | Skin.HasSetting(Indicator.TraktFavourites)]">
                    <param name="listitem">$PARAM[listitem]</param>
                </include>

                <include content="Layout_Labels_ShowTitle" condition="![$PARAM[detailed]]">
                    <param name="top">10</param>
                    <param name="item_h">$PARAM[item_h]</param>
                    <param name="item_w">$PARAM[item_w]</param>
                    <param name="selected">$PARAM[selected]</param>
                    <param name="affix">$PARAM[affix]</param>
                    <param name="listitem">$PARAM[listitem]</param>
                    <param name="textcolor">$PARAM[textcolor]</param>
                    <param name="use_label2">$PARAM[use_label2]</param>
                </include>

                <include content="Object_SelectBox" condition="$PARAM[selected]">
                    <param name="affix">$PARAM[affix]</param>
                    <param name="indicator">true</param>
                    <param name="focusbounce">true</param>
                    <param name="listitem">$PARAM[listitem]</param>
                </include>
            </control>
        </definition>
    </include>

    <include name="List_Landscape_Row">

<variable name="Label_ShowTitle_Upper">
        <value condition="!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.TVShowTitle) + !String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBType,tvshow)">$INFO[ListItem.TVShowTitle,,:]</value>
        <value>$INFO[ListItem.Label]</value>
    </variable>

    <variable name="Label_ShowTitle_Lower">
        <value condition="!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.TVShowTitle) + !String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBType,tvshow) + !String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Season) + !String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Episode) + !String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Title) + !String.StartsWith(ListItem.Title,Episode )">$VAR[Label_Plot_Episode_Number]$INFO[ListItem.Title, - ,]</value>
        <value condition="!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.TVShowTitle) + !String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBType,tvshow) + !String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Season) + !String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Episode)">$VAR[Label_Plot_Episode_Number]</value>
        <value condition="!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.TVShowTitle) + !String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBType,tvshow) + !String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Title) + !String.StartsWith(ListItem.Title,Episode )">$INFO[ListItem.Title]</value>
    </variable>

    <variable name="Label_Widget_Style">
        <value condition="String.IsEqual(ListItem.Property(widget_style),LandscapeShowArt)">Landscape with show title and art</value>
